title: Ai Ore! Love Me!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Mizuki is the boyish 'prince' of her all-girls school and lead guitarist of an all-girl rock band; Akira is the feminine-looking 'princess' of his all-boys school who wants to join her band and win her. When the band's singer moves overseas, Akira pushes to join, and a romance develops amid constant gender mix-ups.
life_message: A good life means accepting both sides of yourself and loving boldly, though the story's hero pursues love forcefully.

content.note: Sexual coercion: near-assaults, including attempted rape, become a prevalent theme late in volume 1 (ANN review; MangaUpdates Mature). ANN says Shinjo uses it as a weapon and doesn't romanticize it. Capped at 3: one source (to verify).
Threat of sexual violence and a cliffhanger (ANN); one source, capped (to verify).

High-school leads; Akira forces a kiss, pins Mizuki and tries to have sex with her at least three times in volume 1 (ANN). MangaUpdates genres Smut and Mature; MangaDex erotica. ANN expects later volumes to be racier. Viz rated Older Teen per ANN.
Akira's possessive, forceful pursuit is the romantic lead's behavior; ANN calls it off-putting.
